leadText:
I'll Always Remember You is one of the ending themes for the English dub of The Rise of Darkrai, which is accompanied by Living in the Shadow. It is sung by Kirsten Price. It replaced I Will Be With You (Where the Lost Ones Go). It is used as one of the ending themes for Arceus and the Jewel of Life. 

A remixed version was used for 's flashbacks to Riding the Winds of Change!, Fighting Fear with Fear!, and Dealing with Defensive Types! in Mastering Current Events!.
